data: Artificial complete four-field eight-value contexts, four labels. Disjoint balanced A/B/C/D/E groups of size g; pool half A plus half B. 128 never-taught probes. New data/code seeds; case construction reused from v0.2. Not language, partial observation or P1/S1 integration.
timeline: Base A then B then C, four passes each. Acquisition16; post_q16. Silent world change and drift_only observation. Background D two passes; post_D. Another16 previously acquisition-unvisited teachers; post_q32. Background E two passes; post_E. All teachers correct for current world. Main sees base, background and acquisition. Protected auxiliary sees only acquisition, without extra external presentations.
acquisition: An independent main512 stationary reference precomputes the 32 once-only least-margin requests using only that reference's current scores, unlabeled pool and deterministic hash ties. Its own sequential teacher responses update the reference. The resulting context plan is replayed identically in all six arms and both worlds. It is NOT each arm's autonomous active selection. Reference construction has additional compute and teacher presentations, reported separately. No auxiliary alarm affects the plan or main prediction.
drift: After first16 acquisitions, silently rotate labels of first8 queried contexts plus hash-first8 not-yet-queried pool contexts. All other labels unchanged. This deliberately provides8 stale protected memories, not a random population drift estimate. q16 and drift_only have identical weights, ledger, observables in both worlds while evaluator truth differs. No change indication is passed to runtime.
trace_pair: Four independent128-dimensional complex phase pair superpositions T[k]. z[k,y]=context_product[k]*label_atom[k,y]. Mean correlation over four banks reads the four labels. Acquisition-only shared simultaneous residual update T[k]+=sum_y(onehot_teacher[y]-mean_score[y])*z[k,y], gain1. Candidate labels in this update come from the one external teacher, not model pseudo-teachers. This approximately revises earlier correspondence without an exact old-label dictionary; latest-label retention is fallible.
main: Four complex phase banks and four label coefficient vectors, same shared residual lr0.5 as v0.2. d=128/160/96 yields32768/40960/24576 bytes. Main512 symbols exactly match old core for same seed. Main acceptance remains unique score>=0.5, no detector-induced filtering.
controls: pair trace512 complex coefficients=8192 bytes. main512_pair40960 bytes versus main64040960. main384_pair32768 versus main51232768. main512 versus main512_pair identical main updates. Protected bank trace uses4 banks*4 labels*32 dimensions=8192 bytes and the same acquisition-only gain1 residual updates. main512_bank therefore40960 bytes and tests whether pairing is better than merely protecting teacher information in a label-separated SS memory. main384 isolates the reduced main. Atom caches, ledger bytes, updates and time also reported; coefficient equality is not total RAM/FLOPs equality.
detectors: Cooldown64 updates for ledger contexts. gap_drop: last post-teacher main top-two gap minus current gap>=0.15. SS trace confidence: exactly one trace mean score>=0.5 and top-two gap>=0.15. ss_disagreement: confident trace candidate differs from current main tentative, including main tie. ss_weak_support: confident trace candidate's current main score exceeds all alternatives by at most0.15. Both require cooldown. Unregistered contexts may still produce spurious trace support, measured separately without ledger eligibility.
metrics: At post_D and post_E report confusion counts, precision and recall against latest externally taught label for all acquired contexts and for those immediately correct after acquisition; first16 true-wrong-to-correct cohort separately. Trace accuracy against last teacher, stale-trace agreement against current world truth, and never-taught false trace acceptance/confidence. All labels/cohort flags used only in evaluator. Shadow top4 alarms rank by score disagreement (gap baseline by current small gap), each counted as a hypothetical paid recheck; no teacher is actually acquired and no retention improvement is claimed. Whole old A+B accepted correct/wrong/abstain, protected nonpool and unknown main false acceptance.
frozen_settings: No development optimization or final-data tuning. Gains, thresholds, seeds, timeline, metrics fixed before final evaluation. Unit/micro tests use separate seeds only. Primary descriptive endpoint: stationary post_E teacher-aligned relapse detection in immediately-correct acquired cohort, compared with gap_drop and protected bank at identical main size. Secondary endpoints must not replace it after seeing results.
sample_units: 16 data/code/size bases; 192 arm/world trajectories. Each size/world/arm has8 data-code runs but only4 independently generated datasets crossed with2 symbol seeds. Repeated checkpoints and arms are paired, not independent samples. Descriptive counts and paired per-run deltas, no p-values or general population guarantee.
limits: Observation-only release. Exact teacher labels allowed only in external feedback/examples and evaluator evidence, never saved runtime ledger. Scores not probabilities. Auxiliary disagreement is not proof of error and cannot reveal a changed world when both memories agree with an obsolete teacher. Correct teachers assumed; no noisy-teacher robustness claim. No autonomous acquisition improvement, downstream retention improvement, natural language generation, all-SS control, biological validation, Linux verification or P1/S1 integration. eligible_for_inference=false. Future detector-controlled trials require a separate frozen experiment.
